name: ua-vehicle-registry-data-quality
title: UA Vehicle Registry — Data Quality Edition
description: A normalized and data-quality enhanced derivative of the Ukrainian public-sector open dataset 'Відомості про транспортні засоби та їх власників', designed for reproducible analytical use. Schema 2.0 (from the 2026-04 snapshot): record_ids became record_id, power_kwt was added, and reg_addr_koatuu, n_reg_new, n_reg_latin and is_valid_plate are omitted from snapshots from 2026-05 onward because the source registry stopped publishing them.

sources.title: Відомості про транспортні засоби та їх власників

fields.name: record_id
fields.description: Source record ID. Named record_ids (array) in snapshots up to 2026-03.

fields.name: person_type
fields.description: Type of owner: P = natural person, J = legal entity

fields.name: reg_addr_koatuu
fields.description: KOATUU code of the owner's registered address. Absent from snapshots from 2026-05 onward.

fields.name: oper_code
fields.description: Numeric code of the registration operation

fields.name: oper_name
fields.description: Human-readable name of the registration operation

fields.name: dep_code
fields.description: Code of the service center. String to preserve leading zeros; recovered from the service center name from 2026-05.

fields.name: vin
fields.description: Vehicle Identification Number. Null for records predating July 2021.

fields.name: power_kwt
fields.description: Engine power in kW. Added in schema 2.0; in the source from 2026-05, carried onto earlier registrations by VIN.

fields.name: n_reg_new
fields.description: Vehicle registration plate number (new format). Absent from snapshots from 2026-05 onward.

fields.name: n_reg_latin
fields.description: Registration plate transliterated to Latin characters. Absent from snapshots from 2026-05 onward.

fields.name: is_valid_plate
fields.description: Whether the registration plate passes format validation. Absent from snapshots from 2026-05 onward.

fields.name: raw_vin
fields.description: Original VIN from source. Null before 2021

fields.name: is_valid_vin
fields.description: Whether the VIN passes validation. Null before 2021
